name: The Overlord (far)
description: a giant obsidian titan seen from far away on a ledge, red glowing eyes, a crown of black horns, broad shoulders in a heavy cloak of black stone, his back and one shoulder to the viewer, tired posture, no expression; a dark silhouette lit only by lava glow from below

poses.stand: standing on a ledge in profile looking up, one hand resting on a horn of his crown
poses.walk: mid-stride in profile, heavy sack over one shoulder
poses.lift: standing on a small chain lift platform, back to the viewer, looking up

idle.action: breathes slowly, shoulders rising and falling, eyes glowing

walk.action: walks slowly along the ledge, unhurried
